query: SELECT e.patient_id, e.created_at, d.name AS "department?", doc.full_name AS "doctor?", COALESCE(tok.number, q.token_number::text) AS token_number, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounters prev WHERE prev.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND prev.patient_id = e.patient_id AND prev.encounter_type = 'opd' AND prev.deleted_at IS NULL AND prev.id <> e.id AND prev.created_at < e.created_at) AS "is_repeat!" FROM encounters e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id AND d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN users doc ON doc.id = e.doctor_id AND doc.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.number FROM tokens t WHERE t.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND t.module = 'opd' AND t.entity_type = 'encounter' AND t.entity_id = e.id ORDER BY t.created_at LIMIT 1) tok ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT oq.token_number FROM opd_queues oq WHERE oq.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND oq.encounter_id = e.id AND oq.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY oq.created_at LIMIT 1) q ON true WHERE e.id = $1 AND e.tenant_id = $2 AND e.encounter_type = 'opd' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
